notes.title: ANTHONY THE MONK ALPHA 1 - UPDATED
notes.content:
This small update gives new sound effects to the player, enemies and a new soundtrack for each level

[list]
[*] New composed Score for each level
[*] Fixed miniboss at the end
[*] New sounds for the player
[*] Added a new colour grade
[*] Ravens added and will sometimes drop bread
[/list]

Go to the Discord Link for more future updates!
